summary: Outsmart the bacteria. An aluminum-free solid that alters the underarm pH to create a hostile environment for odor-causing microbes.
description: Biological odor engineering. Rather than masking scent with heavy perfumes, this enzymatic formula utilizes a specialized ferment to break down sweat before bacteria can interact with it, ensuring 24-hour neutrality.
technical_overview: Offered at $18.0 for 75g, this KoColor DEODORANT is expertly formulated with Propylene Glycol, Saccharomyces Ferment Filtrate, and Arrowroot Powder. It delivers a high-fidelity Clear Solid color profile (`#F8F8FF`) and leverages enzymatic odor degradation.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Swipe 2-3 times to clean, dry underarms daily.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Allow a 2-week transition period if switching from antiperspirants, as the body purges trapped aluminum salts.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Arrowroot powder acts as a highly effective, natural moisture absorbent without the abrasive texture of baking soda.
